maps.namePlaceholder: The campaign, the city, the court
maps.cannotCreate: Ask your GM to make a collection of relationship maps. Making one needs the Trusted Player role; once it exists, you can draw on its maps.
maps.deleteBody: {name} will be deleted, along with all {boards} of its map(s) and the {people} person(s) standing on them. Nobody's actor is touched, and this cannot be undone.
maps.deleteBodyEmpty: {name} will be deleted. It has no maps in it, and this cannot be undone.
maps.newHint: Start another collection. It opens with no maps in it, ready for you to add the first.

pages.label: Maps in this collection
pages.placeholder: The court, the docks, who owes whom
pages.newHint: Start another map in this collection, with nobody on it yet. Each map has its own people, its own lines and its own layout, and starts out hidden from the players until the GM shows it.
pages.added: {name} has been added, and is the map you are on.
pages.hideHint: Hide this map from your players. Nothing on it is lost or changed: the people, the lines and the layout stay exactly as they are, and only you can see them until you show the map again.
pages.showHint: Show this map to your players. They will be able to see it, and to move people and draw lines on it, as they can on every map you have shown them.
pages.shown: {name} is now shown to your players.
pages.renameHint: Rename the map you are on.
pages.deleteHint: Delete the map you are on, and everyone on it. The other maps in this collection are untouched.
pages.deleteBody: {name} will be deleted. Nobody is on it, and the other maps in this collection are untouched.
pages.deleteBodyPeople: {name} will be deleted, along with the {count} person(s) on it and every line drawn between them. Their actors are not touched, and neither are the other maps in this collection.
pages.orderHint: Drag a map along the strip to put it in a different order, or hold Ctrl and press the left or right arrow key. The order is the whole table's: everyone sees these maps in the order you leave them in.
pages.failed: That map could not be made. You may no longer have permission to change this collection.
pages.moveFailed: That map could not be moved. You may no longer have permission to change this collection.
pages.noneLead: This collection has no maps yet.
pages.noneHint: Add the first one with New map, or with the + beside the tabs.
pages.noneHintReadonly: Whoever keeps this collection has not added a map to it yet.

RELMAP.hideLabelsHint: Take the writing off every line on this map, leaving the faces and the lines between them. On a crowded map the words are what makes it hard to read. Nothing is deleted or changed, nobody else's window is touched, and unticking this brings every word straight back. Click a line and its own words come back while you have it, so you can still read and write on one.

labelsNow.on: The words along the lines are hidden. The lines and everybody on the map are still there.
labelsNow.off: The words along the lines are showing again.

history.backHint: Take back {what}. Yours alone: it takes back what you did on this map, and never what anyone else at the table did. Ctrl+Z.
history.backNothing: There is nothing of yours on this map to take back.
history.forwardNothing: There is nothing to do again.
history.gone: That cannot be taken back any more: everyone it was about has since been taken off this map.

RELMAP.weightGroup: How heavily this map is drawn, for you

head.name: Arrowheads
head.hint: How big the arrowheads on the lines are drawn, as a percentage. Only lines that say which way they are read carry one, and on a map with a lot of people on it they are small. This is yours alone: it changes every map you open and nobody else's window, and nothing on the map itself is altered.

line.name: Lines
line.hint: How thick the lines between people are drawn, as a percentage. Broken and dotted lines open up to match, so a dotted line still reads as dotted at any weight. This is yours alone: it changes every map you open and nobody else's window, and nothing on the map itself is altered.

word.name: Words
word.hint: How big the writing along the lines is set, as a percentage. Any line you have given a size of its own grows by the same share, so the loud ones stay louder than the quiet ones. This is yours alone: it changes every map you open and nobody else's window, and nothing on the map itself is altered.

people.unpick: {name}. Click to take them back off.
people.noMatches: Nobody on this list matches what you typed. The counts beside the other lists say where they are.
people.selectAllHint: Tick every name this list is showing. Type in the find box first to tick fewer.

groupHints.others: People on this map with no actor behind them.

RELMAP.inkLightened: {chose} was too dark to follow on this map, so this line is drawn in {used}.

highContrast.name: High-contrast relationship maps
highContrast.hint: Draws every relationship map for a reader who cannot rely on colour: the eight line colours are darkened (or lightened, on the dark theme) to 4.5:1, each is drawn with its own dash pattern, and every face gets a heavier rim. Only on your screen.

restoreWindows.name: Reopen relationship maps after a reload
restoreWindows.hint: When you reload, any relationship map you had open comes back where you left it, on the map you were looking at. Only on your screen.
